description: Use when you need a current, citable exchange rate: returns the latest European Central Bank reference rates (published once per working day around 16:00 CET) for about 30 major currencies, re-based to any supported currency, optionally filtered to the symbols you need. Includes the rate date so you know how fresh it is. Not for trading; for pricing, reporting, invoicing and conversions. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies; all ~30 if omitted.
